name: v2.0.1
body:
**Changed:** Extended the handling of Now Playing (NP) for the following use cases: 
- Pause clears NP, resume sends it again.
- Stop clears NP. Quitting foobar2000 doesn't clear NP to avoid slowing down the shutdown process.
- "Pause scrobbling" from the menubar clears it, "Resume scrobbling" resends it when a track is playing and is not filter-excluded.
- "Disable Now Playing notifications" from preferences clears it, and sends it when gets unchecked while a track is playing.
- Unsetting/setting the FOO_SCROBBLER tag during playback: 1 to 0 clears it, 0 to 1 sends it.
- Moving to a track that is excluded by filters | tag is set to 0 | not in the library | missing artist/title -> clears the previous track's NP.
- Authenticating to Last.fm during playback sends NP.
- Editing playing track metadata resends it with the new title, if the track becomes excluded, clears it.
- Streams undergo the same rules.
- Debug console log prints "NowPlaying removed" when NP is cleared.

**Fixed:** Per-scrobble refusals within batches from Last.fm are now logged correctly to the console.
**Fixed:** Local tracks with no Artist field and a Title containing '-' now aren't parsed for NP. No scrobbling for these tracks either before or now.

name: v2.0.0
body:
**Changed:** JSON key scanners are replaced with a strict parser written from scratch.  It is suited for a Last.fm scrobbler's requirements.

**Changed:** Worker HTTP calls are now cancellable so exit doesn't block on a stalled socket.
  
**Changed:** Using the new JSON parser, detection and handling of Last.fm per-track scrobble refusals of dispatched batches, became feasible and implemented. Not consuming daily budget anymore.

**Fixed:** Refresh pending metadata by queue entry id.  

**Changed:** Now catching regex errors at match time.

**Changed:** The maximum daily scrobble submission budget is now set to 900 from 2600. Last.fm recently lowered the daily limit to a value close to 669. When users reach this limit, they become rate-limited for the day. Foo Scrobbler already handles this state with queue rate-limiting and cooldown.

name: v1.5.7
body:
**Changed:** Passing _musicbrainz_trackid_  through the Title Formatting pipeline (Tag Formatting prefs). Update the MusicBrainz track ID on tag edits during playback, as with other fields.   

**Fixed:** Reworked edge-case logic where seekbar moves were affecting the listened time.

name: v1.5.6
body: **Fixed:** Tracker now persists any eligible pending stream scrobble to the queue during shutdown.

name: v1.5.5
body:
**Fixed:** Trust foobar2000's pre-split artist and title tags for streams instead of re-parsing a combined "Artist – Title" string first, so stations that already expose separate fields are no longer mis-split.

**Fixed:** An edge case where a deferred scrobble could be skipped if playback was paused right as the track ended or switched.

**Changed:** Refresh the FOO_SCROBBLER tag state only on tag edits, at track start, and before submission.

**Added:** Option to hide the Last.fm submenu from the Playback menu, enabled by default and greyed out while signed out.

**Changed:** Run the Last.fm authentication flow on a background thread, with a guard that prevents overlapping authentication requests.

name: v1.5.4
body:
**Fixed:** Apply Title Formatting input scripts to stream metadata so streams honor the same formatting as local files before Now Playing and scrobbling.

**Changed:** Recognize short CJK (Chinese/Japanese/Korean) titles so 1–2 character stream titles are no longer filtered out as station noise.

name: v1.5.3
body:
**Changed:** Deferred filtered dynamic tracks instead of rejecting them immediately, matching the recovery behavior already used for local files. While a filter is blocking the current stream track, playback state is preserved and rechecked, so if the user removes the filter before the track ends, it can still become eligible for scrobbling.

**Changed:** Further separated the dynamic stream and local file tracker paths to keep their playback and scrobbling state handling clearer.

**Changed:** Moved shared tracker helper logic into utility code so parsing and classification helpers can be reused outside the tracker.

name: v1.5.2
body:
**Changed:** Improved Various Artists field validation to catch more common VA values.

**Changed:** Deferred tracks that are not yet in the library instead of rejecting them immediately when “Only scrobble from media library” is enabled.

**Fixed:** UTF-8 handling in the station title heuristic for dynamic streams.

**Changed:** Made exclusion substring matching Unicode-aware.

name: v1.5.1
body:
**Added:** An authentication status indicator to the Console tab in Preferences, making it easier to verify whether the Last.fm account is currently authenticated.

**Changed:** Disabled the Dynamic sources combo box when “Scrobble only from media library” is enabled, since dynamic source selection is not applicable in that mode.

**Fixed:** An issue where Now Playing notifications could be sent when scrobbling was resumed (from Pause Scrobbling menu option) while playback was paused.

name: v1.5.0
body:
**Changed:** Replaced the old Advanced settings area with a native Cocoa tabbed pane under `Preferences → Tools → Foo Scrobbler`.

**Added:** Title Formatting exclusion filter templates for genre, media kind, path, and comment.

**Changed:** Improved exclusion behavior so filtered tracks are handled consistently during playback instead of being dropped immediately at track start.

**Changed:** Improved metadata handling for local files and dynamic streams.

**Changed:** Cleaned up retry, scrobbling, settings, and Web API internals.

name: v1.1.2
body:
**Fixed:** Last.fm error 9 handling so Now Playing and queued scrobbles use the same re-authentication path. Stopped repeated “no valid auth state” console spam after an invalid session.

**Changed:** Edited playback metadata is now checked against the same filters before refreshing Now Playing or queued scrobbles. This keeps the FOO_SCROBBLER tag, regex exclusions, and TF exclusions consistent when tags change mid-playback.

name: v1.1.1
body:
**Fixed:** Preserve TF processing order so exclusion filters see the same evaluated artist/title/album fields that are submitted to Last.fm, including dynamic stream metadata updates.
                       
**Changed:** Improve batch scrobbling error logs with named results, batch size, Last.fm API error numbers and API messages.
                       
**Changed:** Use backed-off, not-yet-due scrobbles to fill spare batch slots for small queues, while keeping due scrobbles first.

name: v1.1.0
body:
**Changed:** Updated queue draining to use the API-supported batch scrobbling, reducing overhead and making backlog submission more efficient.

**Fixed:** Rare worker race conditions that could lead to busy spinning or retries being held onto longer than intended.

**Added:** Exclusion filtering using foobar2000 Title Formatting, allowing more flexible rules based on track metadata.

**Added:** Regex filtering support for albums, extending the existing filtering behavior based on regular expressions.

**Removed:** Support for the legacy v1.0.1 short-lived queue format (Only v1.0.1 affected). If you still use this version and the queue contains scrobbles, dispatch first, then update to the latest version.

**Added:** Support for the FOO_SCROBBLER tag flag to skip scrobbling and Now Playing updates when requested by track metadata. Valid case-insensitive values: true, 1, yes, on, and their opposites.

**Changed:** Replaced the deprecated Apple MD5 hashing API with the SDK-native implementation.

**Changed:** Updated the universal build to use Apple Clang 21.

name: v1.0.9
body:
Performance improvements in this release.

**Changed:** Queue access efficiency by avoiding repeated parsing.

**Changed:** Playback-time performance by caching compiled foobar2000 Title Formatting scripts instead of recompiling them each time they are evaluated.

**Changed:** Stream deduplication safety by replacing unsafe static local state with tracker-owned per-instance state.

**Changed:** Handling of Last.fm back-end error 8 so it is now treated as a temporary server-side failure, without consuming the limited retry budget that can lead to scrobble discard.

name: v1.0.7
body:
**Added:** Support for Last.fm rate-limit error 29 through a queue cooldown mechanism. When this error is received, the queue enters cooldown and submits at a reduced rate.

**Added:** Support for MusicBrainz Track ID submission in scrobbles, using the relevant file tag.

**Changed:** Integrated Now Playing handling into the Web API code.

name: v1.0.6
body:
**Added:** Support for foobar2000 Title Formatting. Scrobble metadata fields can now be defined using Title Formatting expressions. Evaluated parameters pass through the normal validation pipeline before queueing, after which regex exclusion filters, if configured, are applied.

**Removed:** The previous tag mapping feature.

name: v1.0.5
body:
**Added:** Regular expression (regex) filtering for excluding specific scrobbles before they are queued. These filters act as a decision policy for rejecting otherwise eligible scrobbles. Users unfamiliar with regex can use an AI assistant or similar tool to generate expressions. See the Wiki for usage details and example patterns. Regex-based rules can also be shared and reused across different scrobblers, including those running on other operating systems and those unrelated to foobar2000.

**Fixed:** Unicode track titles, including Japanese titles, are now handled correctly for Now Playing and scrobbling.

**Changed:** Upgraded the language standard from C++17 to C++20.

**Changed:** Switched the project license to the MIT License.

name: v1.0.2
body:
In this release,

Added: Tag mapping support (Advanced preferences).

Changed: Queued scrobbles are now discarded after 5 consecutive unclassified responses from Last.fm.
This prevents stuck entries that could otherwise remain in the local queue database indefinitely.

Fixed: Minor bypass of the daily queue drain limit.
Under certain conditions, the 2600 scrobbles/day cap could be exceeded by a small margin.

Changed: Small-queue cooldown-ignore threshold reduced to 50 (from 100).
When the cache size is 0–50, cooldown-based rate limiting is skipped and submissions fire on available time slots.

Removed: Legacy queue-format compatibility (pre-AlbumArtist field).
If you still have cached scrobbles from versions prior to 1.0.0, submit them first, then update to this version.

name: v1.0.1
body: Fix: Include Album Artist in Now Playing and scrobble submissions (compilations support).

name: v1.0.0
body:
Foo Scrobbler for Mac v1.0.0 – native, lightweight foobar2000 scrobbling – foo_scrobbler_mac

•	No third-party dependencies: pure foobar2000 SDK code
•	Small and efficient: low overhead, no helper apps or bundled libraries
•	Predictable behavior: explicit state transitions, stable under long sessions
•	Reliable metadata handling: correct scrobbles and now-playing updates, including streams and radio
•	Complete feature set: authentication, automatic session recovery, persistent queue, dynamic source support

name: v0.9.9
body: Now supporting scrobbling from dynamic sources like radio streams, etc. New options enable the support at Preferences → Advanced → Tools → Foo Scrobbler, where you can choose to only update NowPlaying notifications for dynamic sources, both scrobbling and NP, or None. Keep in mind that if the option to "Only scrobble from media library" is checked, dynamic sources are not scrobbled or NP-notified (have no effect).

name: v0.9.7
body: Improved handling of the errors that might emerge while communicating to Last.fm.

name: v0.9.6
body:
In this release, the internal thread system was refactored which increases stability. This also facilitates the control of the submission rate of the local scrobble cache to meet Last.fm requirements, i.e., maximum number of scrobbles per day, and 2 weeks. The rate is also consistent, without load variations throughout the day. If the cache size is small, e.g., less than 100 scrobbles, rate control is not used. Scrobble cache always drains in batches of maximum 10 items per slot (play/stop.. etc).

A bug was fixed related to authentication when it was not completed the first time (stopped by the user) and a foobar2000 restart was required to be able to perform it again. 

Finally, if a different user authenticates, the local scrobble cache, if populated, is cleared.

name: v0.9.5
body: In this release, new configuration fields in Preferences → Advanced → Tools → Foo Scrobbler are introduced. These are options, (a) to only scrobble tracks from the media library, (b) to set the console info level: none, basic or debug, and (c) to disable NowPlaying notifications.

name: v0.7.7
body: Bug fixes. Update recommended.

name: v0.7.6
body: Regression fixes about the cache submission policy. Also, a rule about the seeker was removed.

name: v0.7.5
body: Now, candidate scrobbles with malformed tags are rejected from submission. Also, a linear back-off retry strategy per scrobble was added for the queue. Finally, internal code improvements designed and implemented.

name: v0.7.3
body: This release brings to the table improvements related to the communication with Last.fm and a more robust internal timing system. Also, a few features were added, like the temporary suspension of scrobbling without being unauthenticated, the update of tags during playback will now be detected, and finally, the seek bar will find it harder to cheat the current scrobble.

name: v0.7.0
body:
**Foo Scrobbler for Mac**

This is the initial release v0.7.0 of Foo Scrobbler for Mac. It is a foobar2000 plugin for Last.fm on macOS. Submit audio track information to Last.fm while listening. Then checkout there the history and statistics.

**Basic traits:**
    
Native macOS Last.fm scrobbling
Smart submission logic
Automatic offline caching
Accurate “Now Playing” handling
Fully aligned with Last.fm API specifications.
Minimal user interaction
Lightweight and efficient
Strict playback validation
Open-source (GPLv3)
Built specifically for foobar2000 on macOS
